description: Na₃DyBr₆ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. There are two inequivalent Na¹⁺ sites. In the first Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded to six Br¹⁻ atoms to form NaBr₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent DyBr₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 42-46°. There are a spread of Na-Br bond distances ranging from 2.87-3.01 Å. In the second Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven Br¹⁻ atoms. There are a spread of Na-Br bond distances ranging from 2.96-3.63 Å. Dy³⁺ is bonded to six Br¹⁻ atoms to form DyBr₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaBr₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 42-46°. There are a spread of Dy-Br bond distances ranging from 2.77-2.81 Å. There are three inequivalent Br¹⁻ sites. In the first Br¹⁻ site, Br¹⁻ is bonded to three Na¹⁺ and one Dy³⁺ atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing BrNa₃Dy trigonal pyramids. In the second Br¹⁻ site, Br¹⁻ is bonded to three Na¹⁺ and one Dy³⁺ atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing BrNa₃Dy trigonal pyramids. In the third Br¹⁻ site, Br¹⁻ is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four Na¹⁺ and one Dy³⁺ atom.
